newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three Israelis hurt in Jerusalem market blast.
newsitem.headline: Three Israelis hurt in Jerusalem market blast.

text.p: At least three Israelis were wounded in a blast at an outdoor market in Jerusalem on Wednesday, Israel Radio said.
"There was a bomb in the market a few minutes ago and of course there are casualties," said a police spokeswoman.
The blast occurred in the Mahaneh Yehuda market in central Jerusalem at about 1:15 p.m. (1015 GMT). People in the area said they heard one or two explosions followed by sirens of ambulances.
